versionMismatch: The system has been updated. Please reload the page.

codes.invalid_request: The request is invalid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
codes.currency_change_blocked: The currency cannot change while the order has with-checkout costs. Remove or void them first.
codes.version_conflict: This item was changed by someone else. The latest version has been reloaded; review it and try again.
codes.invalid_transition: This action is not allowed in the current state. The latest state has been reloaded.
codes.vendor_name_taken: A vendor with this name or alias already exists.
codes.team_slug_taken: A team with this slug already exists.
codes.team_archived: This team is archived and read-only.
codes.subgroup_name_conflict: This name or alias is already used by another subgroup of the team (inactive subgroups included).
codes.subgroup_name_conflict_value: “{{value}}” is already used as a name or alias by another subgroup of the team (inactive subgroups included).
codes.member_no_role_source: This member has no SSO role, so the manual role cannot be cleared. Remove the member instead.
codes.member_managed_by_sso: This membership is managed by SSO and cannot be removed here.
codes.if_match_required: The request is missing version information. Reload the page and try again.
codes.invalid_if_match: The request carried invalid version information. Reload the page and try again.
codes.batch_not_collecting: This batch is not accepting items.
codes.batch_not_reviewing: This batch is not under review.
codes.batch_closed: This batch is closed and can no longer be edited.
codes.assignments_incomplete: Assign at least one approver first.
codes.deadline_not_in_future: The deadline must be in the future.
codes.no_pending_items: There are no pending items to review.
codes.item_not_deletable: This item can no longer be deleted. Withdraw it instead.
codes.item_not_editable: This item can no longer be edited or withdrawn.
codes.item_not_edited: Edit the item or add a reply before resubmitting it.
codes.item_not_reviewable: One of the items can no longer be reviewed (it may have been decided already).
codes.batch_item_limit: This batch has reached the maximum number of items (5000).
codes.blocked_by_dependency: Other records depend on this. Undo them first.
codes.items_undecided: Every item must be approved or rejected before the review can be confirmed.
codes.line_quantity_exceeded: Line #{{lineNo}} can take only {{remaining}} more. Lower the quantity; the rest can stay pending or be marked as not needing a match.
codes.shared_cost_allocation_invalid: The split of a cost entry does not match the lines or teams on this order.
codes.item_not_purchasable: This item cannot be ordered: it must be approved in a review-confirmed batch and not marked unpurchasable.
codes.item_already_on_order: This item already has a line on this order.
codes.order_not_draft: Lines can only be added or removed while the order is a draft.
codes.order_locked: The vendor and currency cannot change once the order is placed.
codes.line_locked: The quantity and team are locked once the order is placed.
codes.unit_price_required: A placed line must keep its unit price.
codes.line_missing_price: Every line needs a unit price before the order can be placed.
codes.order_not_placed: Refunds and extra charges can only be added to a placed order.
codes.cost_entry_voided: This entry is voided and can no longer be changed.
codes.line_not_closable: Only lines that are short and have no open problem can be closed.
codes.line_not_matchable: That vendor order line cannot take deliveries: its order is not placed or the line is closed. Reopen the line or choose another one.
codes.lookup_not_found: No product was found for that SKU or URL. You can fill in the item by hand.

conflictKeptEdits: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Your changes are kept and the fields you did not touch now show the latest values; save again to apply your changes.
order_not_placed: Refunds and extra charges can be added only to a placed order, and cost entries can be voided only on a placed order (delete them in a draft).
